# Far Fox

> Far Fox (lovefarfox.com) is a relationship app for long-distance couples. Both partners join one private space and build a daily connection ritual: daily questions, love letters, photo sharing, couple challenges, reunion countdowns, and a shared virtual fox that grows as the couple shows up for each other. It is free to start. The site also offers free, no-signup tools for couples who live apart: a love language quiz, a time-zone overlap calculator, a halfway point calculator, and a reunion countdown.

## Product

- [Long-distance relationship app overview](https://lovefarfox.com/long-distance-relationship-app/): what Far Fox does for couples who live apart, with FAQ
- [Far Fox vs other couples apps](https://lovefarfox.com/compare/): honest comparisons with Paired, Couple, Between, Lasting, and LokLok, including each competitor's strengths

## Free tools

- [All free tools](https://lovefarfox.com/tools/): index of the no-signup tools for long-distance couples
- [Love language quiz for couples](https://lovefarfox.com/quiz/): 6 questions, 2 minutes; both partners take it and get a shareable match reveal
- [Long-distance relationship quiz](https://lovefarfox.com/long-distance-relationship-quiz/): how the quiz works for LDR couples, with FAQ
- [Time zone overlap calculator](https://lovefarfox.com/long-distance-time-zone-calculator/): pick two cities, see the hour difference and waking-hour overlap, including daylight saving
- [Halfway point calculator](https://lovefarfox.com/halfway-point-calculator/): the midpoint between two cities plus the fairest real cities to meet in and how far each partner travels
- [Reunion countdown](https://lovefarfox.com/reunion-countdown/): count the days to the next visit, share it with a partner, download a story card

## Shop

- [Personalized long-distance map](https://lovefarfox.com/personalized-long-distance-map/): instant, print-ready digital map of two cities with names and a message
- [Personalized long-distance jersey](https://lovefarfox.com/personalized-long-distance-jersey/): one-of-one Long Distance FC jersey with a partner's name and number
